name: Bonsai 2 demo set
command:
P=luigi@spark; for spec in "seasons|List the four seasons and one thing that changes in each.|/tmp/b2ans2.json" "haiku|Write a haiku about the sea.|/tmp/b2ans3.json"; do
  name="${spec%%|*}"; rest="${spec#*|}"; prompt="${rest%%|*}"; out="${rest##*|}"
  echo "=== $name"
  ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ServerAliveInterval=30 -o ServerAliveCountMax=20 $P "curl -s -m 1800 http://127.0.0.1:8090/v1/chat/completions -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{\"messages\":[{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"$prompt\"}],\"max_tokens\":2048,\"temperature\":0.5,\"stream\":false}' > $out 2>/dev/null; echo done $name"
done 2>&1 | tail -4
description: Two more Bonsai 2 demo prompts (seasons list for gen1 comparability, haiku)
